{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled IPC; adds `interfaces::Snapshot` in `src/interfaces/snapshot.h`, updates `src/interfaces/node.h`, and implements interface bindings in `src/node/interfaces.cpp`.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Exposes UTXO snapshot loading and progress notifications on `interfaces::Node`, directly unblocking GUI assumeutxo loading. The change has active downstream consumers waiting on it, specifically bitcoin-core/gui#870 and bitcoin-core/gui-qml#488."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches `src/kernel/notifications_interface.h` (+1/-0) solely to plumb snapshot progress notifications through to node interfaces.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The single-line notification addition is mechanical plumbing to support node interfaces rather than a substantive development of the kernel library API."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches `src/validation.cpp` only for assumeutxo progress reporting; does not touch mempool or policy rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR has no connection to mempool structures, transaction validation, or relay policy."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes `src/rpc/blockchain.cpp` to delegate `loadtxoutset` handling to the interface, altering return error codes.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Refactoring `loadtxoutset` changes failure error codes from `RPC_INVALID_PARAMETER` and `RPC_DESERIALIZATION_ERROR` to `RPC_INTERNAL_ERROR`. This alters compatibility for callers handling snapshot loading errors, though the RPC change itself is primarily a test harness for the interface."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches `src/validation.cpp` (+6/-0) to trigger progress callbacks during snapshot loading.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Emitting progress notifications during snapshot population does not change validation logic, consensus behavior, or chainstate invariants."
    }
  ],
